rule: Correlations are computed only from officially sourced numbers, and every value is published with its n. No third-party line, price, or player-prop input is used. Correlations describe the historical record; they are not a betting edge.

rows.pair: point differential vs win percentage, all 32 teams
rows.method: Pearson r on official standings (PF-PA) vs W/(W+L+T)

rows.pair: home win rate vs season win percentage, all 32 teams
rows.method: Pearson r on official home win% (HOME) vs season win% (PCT)

rows.pair: home win rate, Week 10 decided games
rows.method: Share of home wins among Week 10 games with a final score

rows.pair: cross-game leg dependence (moneyline sides, different games)
rows.method: reported from peer-verified data (nfl-command/nfl-lines), not recomputed in this namespace
rows.inputs_official: derivation only; underlying prices are third-party
rows.status: reported, not recomputed — see Flagged MK-01

rows.method: refused: no official prop prices or per-game prop outcomes exist
rows.inputs_official: none — the NFL publishes no prop prices

rows.method: refused: requires multiple seasons of designations joined to official inactive lists; no archived injury snapshots exist

note: CR-01, CR-02 and CR-03 are computed by build.py from the official standings and Week 10 schedule; their r, CI and p appear on the Correlations page with n. All other rows are blank by rule because the required official inputs do not exist.
